name: Castalla Current Topography Reference v4
target: present-day recognizable Cerro del Castell de Castalla

notes: The hill mass is rebuilt to match the current recognizable compact rocky summit and asymmetric slopes.
Summit elevation is anchored to the official Ayuntamiento value of 780 m a.s.l.
Steep western/southern faces and gentler eastern/southeastern access slope are modeled from present aerial visual references.
This is not a direct rasterization of raw LiDAR/DEM and must not be described as centimetric or survey-exact.

recommendedUpgrade: Replace terrain geometry later with an official PNOA-LiDAR MDT02/MDT05 extract registered to the same WGS84 center if raw DEM access is available.
